Shell Plc Sponsored ADR: Strong LNG, Cash Flow, Earnings
: Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (SHEL) Q2: 18 million tonnes LNG sold, $9.8B adjusted earnings, $21.4B operating cash flow, $17.5B free cash flow; notes ~36M tonnes Middle East LNG out of market YTD.
Global Energy Buffers Fall On LNG Losses
: Shell (SHEL) says global energy buffers fell after losing ~36M mt of LNG and 1.6B barrels oil; notes weaker China demand, inventory draws, flexible shipping, U.S. output, and tight gas into 2027
Europe Winter Gas Storage Low Raises Restocking Needs
: SHEL: Shell’s integrated gas head says Europe enters winter with unusually low gas storage, below targets, raising restocking needs and potential seasonal supply pressures traders should monitor.
Shell Intraday Moves On LNG Surge
: SHEL swung intraday: flat early Europe, dropped ~2.4% to $96.58, later jumped ~2.5% to $98.95 on LNG surge, then slid ~1% as Brent and WTI eased.
Shell Buyback: Shares Repurchased Under MAR
: Shell Plc Sponsored ADR (SHEL) repurchased shares for cancellation under its buyback program. Trades ran 30 July–23 Oct 2026, executed by Goldman Sachs International, disclosed per UK/EU MAR rules.
